; A copy of ../sudoku/sudoku-penregion.qmd for the development app Sudoku (corpus), with its own QML id.
; When you change that patch, make the same change here. Only make install-corpus installs this file:
; a release and install.sh do not use it.
; The ink patch of Sudoku: the Pen screen mode of xochitl in the area that Sudoku gives in
; /tmp/sudoku-pen-region ("x y width height", or empty for no area). Sudoku gives the cell of the ink
; while the player writes, thus the ink uses the fast pen waveform (no gaps), and all other updates
; use the UI waveform (correct colors).
; install.sh copies this file to /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/ and starts xovi
; again. xochitl reads it only when it starts. To remove it, delete that copy and run xovi/start.
; The AppLoad patch already imports xofm.libs.epaper as Epaper in this file.
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope
        TRAVERSE Rectangle#mainWindowView > FBController
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem {
                    id: sudokuCorpusPenRegion
                    property var area: []
                    visible: area.length === 4 && root.appName === "Sudoku (corpus)" && !root.minimized && windowCanvas.active
                    x: area.length === 4 ? area[0] : 0
                    y: area.length === 4 ? area[1] : 0
                    width: area.length === 4 ? area[2] : 0
                    height: area.length === 4 ? area[3] : 0
                    objectName: "sudoku-corpus-pen-region"
                    mode: Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Pen
                }
                Timer {
                    property string last: ""
                    interval: 15
                    repeat: true
                    running: root.appName === "Sudoku (corpus)" && windowCanvas.active
                    onTriggered: {
                        let text = "";
                        try {
                            const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
                            request.open("GET", "file:///tmp/sudoku-pen-region", false);
                            request.send();
                            text = request.responseText.trim();
                        } catch (e) {
                            text = "";
                        }
                        if (text !== last) {
                            last = text;
                            const v = text.split(" ").map(Number);
                            sudokuCorpusPenRegion.area = (v.length === 4 && v.every(n => !isNaN(n))) ? v : [];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
